description: Formula pattern pack loaded by the `formulas` operation. Add patterns here instead of editing the tool; both files merge, with this asset overriding built-ins of the same name.

lookup.description: Exact-match lookup with a labelled fallback.
lookup.notes: XLOOKUP requires a Workspace edition that supports it; VLOOKUP is the documented fallback.

conditional_sum.notes: Keep sum_range and criteria ranges the same height; mismatched sizes return #VALUE!.

dynamic_filter.description: Self-expanding filtered output that degrades to a message.
dynamic_filter.notes: The output block must be empty below the formula or the spill returns #REF!.

query_summary.description: SQL-style grouped summary over a range.
query_summary.template: =QUERY({range},"select {select_cols}, sum({sum_col}) where {where} group by {select_cols} order by {select_cols} label sum({sum_col}) '{label}'",1)
query_summary.notes: QUERY columns are letters of the source range; label text uses single quotes.

array_row.description: ARRAYFORMULA helper that survives blank rows.
array_row.notes: Never place a second ARRAYFORMULA in the same spill column.

error_guard.description: Error handling that keeps #N/A distinguishable from real blanks.
error_guard.notes: Prefer IFNA when only #N/A should be swallowed.

date_math.description: Business-day deadline arithmetic with a holiday list.
date_math.notes: Holiday ranges must contain true dates, not text.

text_clean.description: Whitespace and case normalisation in one step.
text_clean.notes: CHAR(160) handles non-breaking spaces that TRIM alone ignores.

percent_of_total.notes: Format the result as a percentage, not as text.

regex_extract.description: Pattern extraction for codes and identifiers.
regex_extract.notes: Google Sheets RE2 has no backreferences or lookbehind.

grade_band.description: Approximate-match band lookup over a sorted threshold table.
grade_band.notes: The threshold range must be sorted ascending; verify the lowest band boundary explicitly.

duplicate_flag.description: Row-level duplicate flag that survives new rows.
duplicate_flag.notes: COUNTIF over the same range scales quadratically; cap the range at the real row count.
